# Security Policy

Thank you for helping keep IELTS AI Pro secure. We take security seriously and appreciate your help in reporting vulnerabilities responsibly.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release of the application is actively supported with security updates. We recommend always running the latest version.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| v1.x    | :white_check_mark: |
| < v1.0  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not open public GitHub issues for security vulnerabilities.**

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it through one of the following secure channels:

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (Recommended):**
   Go to the **Security** tab of this repository, select **Advisories**, and click **Report a vulnerability** to submit your findings privately.

2. **Email Reporting:**
   Alternatively, you can email us directly at [rayan.rizon@gmail.com](mailto:rayan.rizon@gmail.com) with details of the vulnerability.

### What to Include in a Report

To help us triage and resolve the issue quickly, please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Detailed steps to reproduce the issue (PoC scripts, screenshots, or videos are highly appreciated).
- Any details regarding the environment or configuration where the issue was found.

## Disclosure Process

When a report is received:

1. We will acknowledge receipt of your report within 48 hours.
2. We will investigate the issue and coordinate a fix.
3. We aim to resolve reported vulnerabilities within 30 days of receipt.
4. Once resolved, we will publish a security advisory and credit you for the discovery (unless you request to remain anonymous).
